item: R827 R7(a) with R830 (row 408): an intermediate import checkpoint checks only the tables it wrote; the whole corpus file is checked once per run
summary: A per-connection SQLite authorizer records the tables an import group writes; a scoped quick_check and foreign_key_check run at intermediate checkpoints only when every writer is proven instrumented (audit hook, /proc/locks probe), else the full check; the final activation always gets the full check; an owed-check record makes the queue end (or the next start) check the live corpus, latching corruption in the damage registry. Bench: intermediate group 57 s vs 68 s.
